story_type: space shuttle on a 747, last ferry flight
hook: A space shuttle, bolted to a jumbo jet, taking off one last time.
narration: That is a space shuttle riding on top of a jumbo jet, taking to the skies from Kennedy for one last time.
On September nineteenth, 2012, Endeavour began the trip west to Los Angeles atop NASA's Shuttle Carrier Aircraft.
It was the last ferry flight of the shuttle era, capping thirty-five years of shuttles riding on modified 747s.
An orbiter has no jet engines. It glides home from space, so moving one across the country means a piggyback ride.
[short pause] Wheels up came at seven twenty-two in the morning.
Then the pair began a twenty-minute farewell flyover of Florida's Space Coast.
outcome: Endeavour landed at Los Angeles International Airport, bound for public display at the California Science Center.
title: A space shuttle on a jumbo jet
description:
Space shuttle Endeavour took off atop NASA's Shuttle Carrier Aircraft from Kennedy Space Center, Florida, on Sept. 19, 2012, on the last ferry flight of the shuttle era, bound for Los Angeles.
